parsed.why: Decriminalised 2020, no trans-specific offence, constitutional privacy. But police occasionally use modesty charges against gender-nonconforming presentation, individual harassment is common, no gender-identity protection, divided society. Elevated, mid-band; no enforcement record against trans visitors.

Lawful since 1977; gender-identity hate-crime law; documented search protocol for trans persons; legal recognition; guide reports broad acceptance. Offset by inconsistent anti-discrimination enforcement, under-reporting, inadequate hate-crime investigations, anti-gender politics.

Live colonial-era felony statutes (14/7/5 years) reach trans women read as male, though unenforced since 2013; no gender-identity protection, no hate-crime law, no recognition; thin record. Third-gender tradition a weak positive. Elevated.

Criminalised and enforced: 2020 raid, prison terms resting on 'gay appearance'; de facto prohibition of being transgender and of care; police complicity in beatings, torture and killings; no protections or recourse. Severe.

National passport/visa regime forces marker mismatch and possible lifetime inadmissibility on every trans visitor; bathroom bans in ~21 states, four criminal; custody harms documented. State protections, hate-crime law and litigation temper only partly.
